modification_description: The synthesis should explicitly include an escalation path and behavior-based standards beyond dialogue alone: (1) define specific behaviors that create emotional safety (e.g., acceptable 1:1 contact, what constitutes off-limits romantic/therapeutic exclusivity, secrecy norms); (2) include concrete transparency practices (e.g., no hidden DMs, communication norms around outings); (3) set a time-bound review after 4–8 weeks to assess whether boundaries reduce Emma's anxiety without harming Alex's autonomy; (4) state clear consequences, including that if good-faith negotiation fails or agreements are repeatedly violated, the couple should revisit contact levels up to and including distancing or cutting ties as a last resort.
